trigger: Peer review before geometry generation or evaluation: fixed goal plus effectively exact source position can test new-wall transfer but does not test acquisition of a new goal or retention after a conflicting objective.

goal_override.rule: Exclude both A and B goal cells plus10starts from sampled blocked cells. Require all free cells connected to both goals and every start shortest distance<=30 to each. B reward is on entry to pair-specific Bgoal; A return restores(3,3).
goal_override.observation: Goal coordinate, species, phase and taskID are never policy inputs. Goal change must be discovered through own action/reward experience; no invented biological goal-relocation data. Early task ambiguity is a limitation, not a source-prior failure diagnosis.
goal_override.interpretation: A_before isolates novel-topology transfer at source goal; B phases test reward-driven goal/topology adaptation; A_after tests the return to prior goal and topology. No no-forgetting conclusion follows from a nonsignificant delta.

extra_control_design: Source-only fitted goal-bias/persistence synthetic labels on exactly the native sampled observations are a proposed additional control. They require a separate registered source protocol and audited source fits; no extra arm may enter this locked confirmation without a pre-evaluation addendum.
conventional_reference: The earlier fixed-goal planner is a fixed-goal competence reference only. Any relocating-goal/multiple-goal memory planner must be separately specified, code-reviewed and hash-bound before its scientific evaluation; never supply Bgoal to policy.
